## Validation

List the tests, simulations, builds, or measurements performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change does not add synchronous network or maintenance work to startup.
- [ ] Tests cover the new or corrected behavior.
- [ ] Schema, protocol, crypto, or architectural changes include updated documentation and an ADR when required.
- [ ] No real credentials, keys, Vault data, local databases, or personal information are included.
- [ ] Generated Drift output is current.
- [ ] Relevant GitHub Actions checks pass.
